title: HeyGen and Infogram — integration specification
subtitle: How the two APIs lift depth, breadth and branding of every deliverable

elements.heygen: Business plan (4K, up to 300-min videos, API access) — confirm credits per month against volume
elements.infogram: Business plan (brand kit, custom logo and fonts, iframe embeds, SQL connectors, analytics); Enterprise for API at scale

elements.heygen: Video generate (async, webhook on completion); video translation (lip-sync, 175+ languages); streaming/interactive avatar (WebRTC) for Premium Q&A
elements.infogram: copyProject (one copy per job), updateProjectEntities (bind data), publishProject, downloadProject (PNG/JPG/PDF), exportAsHTML; getTaskStatus polling

elements.heygen: OSS-S12 script and render after QA-passed draft; OSS-S15 delivery; OSS-S16 aftercare Q&A
elements.infogram: OSS-S12 render; OSS-S15 publish (Bible Infogram spec)

elements.heygen: Script generated only from the released deliverable (SG-18); avatar ID; voice; language list; brand scene template
elements.infogram: Data tables exported by the Artefact Factory; TBCA brand kit theme; chart template per format

elements.heygen: B: 90-s briefing · S: 3–4-min branded briefing, up to 3 languages · P: 6–8-min digital-twin briefing + interactive avatar for 90 days
elements.infogram: B: 3–5 branded charts · S: interactive report, 8–15 charts · P: live-data dashboard, 12-month hosted link

elements.heygen: SG-18 consent and script fidelity; captions (SG-10); disclaimer frame; no third-party likeness
elements.infogram: SG-19 data binding; SG-09 brand kit; fallback to native renderer with identical data

elements.heygen: Render failure → retry 3× with backoff; then deliver without video and auto-schedule it within 24 h; client notified
elements.infogram: Export failure → native chart render (matplotlib / Zoho Analytics) with the same data (Bible)

elements.heygen: TBCA presenter avatar and scenes; client co-mark at Premium
elements.infogram: TBCA brand kit; client co-mark at Premium

elements.heygen: Every client gets a personal briefing in their own language — most consultancies send a PDF
elements.infogram: Charts stay live and interactive — most consultancies send static images
